facts.note: Nine o'clock by the temple bell; her watch exact, the doctor's two minutes ahead, Girard would not take his out. The habit, the watch-correction remarks and Félix's silver watch are extra colour or not on the sheet, not restatements of its facts.
Worked beside the master in the atelier after dinner; at the temple's ten, the regulator agreed exactly with the bell.
Sent downstairs when the regulator showed twenty past ten; it was running and he was well.
Compared her watch with Rosa's clock in the kitchen; Rosa's clock exactly fifteen minutes fast. The 'on purpose' remark only colours the same fact.
Piano heard from the kitchen, beginning at 10:48 and stopping at 11:01, both by the kitchen clock.
Went straight to the kitchen and stayed with Rosa from arrival until after the temple struck eleven.
